s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness with urinary retention and cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness
Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots
key_facts: MRI brain and orbits showed no abnormality
MRI spine showed nodular thickening and enhancement of lumbosacral nerve roots
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated white blood cell count
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated red blood cell count

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness with urinary retention and cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness
Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots
key_facts: MRI brain and orbits showed no abnormality
MRI spine showed nodular thickening and enhancement of lumbosacral nerve roots
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated white blood cell count
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated red blood cell count

shortlist.label: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions and atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid analysis

shortlist.label: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated white blood cell count and presence of atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid analysis

shortlist.label: Plasma cell leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of nodular thickening and enhancement of lumbosacral nerve roots on MRI spine

shortlist.label: POEMS syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness and urinary retention with cranial nerve involvement

shortlist.label: Neurolymphomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Severe flaccid quadriparesis and reduced muscle stretch reflexes with cranial nerve involvement

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness, urinary retention, and violaceous cutaneous lesions, along with the MRI findings of nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots and the cerebrospinal fluid analysis showing elevated white blood cell count and atypical cells/blasts, are consistent with POEMS syndrome, a rare paraneoplastic syndrome associated with plasma cell dyscrasia.

rejected.label: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia
rejected.why: The presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions and the specific pattern of nerve root involvement are not typical for chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

rejected.label: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia
rejected.why: The subacute progression of symptoms and the presence of nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots are not characteristic of acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

rejected.label: Plasma cell leukemia
rejected.why: While plasma cell leukemia can cause neurological symptoms, the specific combination of symptoms and findings in this case, including the violaceous cutaneous lesions and the pattern of nerve root involvement, are more consistent with POEMS syndrome.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: The presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions and the specific pattern of nerve root involvement, along with the cerebrospinal fluid analysis findings, are not typical for neurolymphomatosis.
